description: Tracks a Subject from repeated record intake through a reviewed, human-approved resolution. WHY defaultDueInHours is 72 and not left null: PRD SS16.4/AGENTS.md require a recorded human Approval before a high-risk outcome executes, and a case with no due date has no way to surface as at-risk on the sla-derived Metric this template demonstrates (dashboards/metrics.json#follow-up-actions-at-risk).
